Oui, à partir de 30 € : sur la page du p: Yes, from €30: on the plugin's page, choose « In 10 payments ». The price, discounted if it is on sale, is split into 10 monthly instalments; the plugin works right away and is yours for good after the last one. Paiement en plusieurs fois. Un plugin On: Paying in instalments. An Onirique plugin of at least €30 can also be paid in 10 monthly instalments, charged each month as a subscription; the total amount is shown before payment. The plugin can be used from the first instalment, under a temporary licence extended with each instalment paid, which becomes permanent after the tenth; charges then stop on their own. You can stop at any time from the Subscription page of the site: the licence ends at the end of the paid month, and instalments already paid are not refunded. An instalment that remains unpaid after the new payment attempts ends the instalment plan under the same conditions.
